verses.translation: By those [angels] lined up in rows
And those who drive [the clouds]
And those who recite the message,
Indeed, your God is One,

verses.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ
verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
verses.transliteration: rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā warabbu l-mashāriqi

verses.arabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
verses.translation: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
verses.transliteration: innā zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bizīnatin l-kawākibi

verses.translation: And as protection against every rebellious devil

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٖ
verses.translation: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
verses.transliteration: lā yassammaʿūna ilā l-mala-i l-aʿlā wayuq'dhafūna min kulli jānibin

verses.translation: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ ثَاقِبٞ
verses.translation: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
verses.transliteration: illā man khaṭifa l-khaṭfata fa-atbaʿahu shihābun thāqibun

verses.arabic: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٖ لَّازِبِۭ
verses.translation: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.
verses.transliteration: fa-is'taftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnā innā khalaqnāhum min ṭīnin lāzibin

verses.translation: But you wonder, while they mock,
And when they are reminded, they remember not.
And when they see a sign, they ridicule.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translation: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
verses.transliteration: waqālū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnun

verses.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
verses.translation: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
verses.transliteration: a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna

verses.translation: And our forefathers [as well]?"
Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.translation: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
verses.transliteration: fa-innamā hiya zajratun wāḥidatun fa-idhā hum yanẓurūna

verses.translation: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
verses.transliteration: hādhā yawmu l-faṣli alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna

verses.arabic: ۞ ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
verses.translation: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
verses.transliteration: uḥ'shurū alladhīna ẓalamū wa-azwājahum wamā kānū yaʿbudūna

verses.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
verses.transliteration: min dūni l-lahi fa-ih'dūhum ilā ṣirāṭi l-jaḥīmi

verses.translation: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
[They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
But they, that Day, are in surrender.
And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
verses.translation: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
verses.transliteration: qālū innakum kuntum tatūnanā ʿani l-yamīni

verses.translation: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا طَٰغِينَ
verses.translation: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
verses.transliteration: wamā kāna lanā ʿalaykum min sul'ṭānin bal kuntum qawman ṭāghīna

verses.arabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
verses.translation: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
verses.transliteration: faḥaqqa ʿalaynā qawlu rabbinā innā ladhāiqūna

verses.translation: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
verses.translation: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant
verses.transliteration: innahum kānū idhā qīla lahum lā ilāha illā l-lahu yastakbirūna

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٖ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
verses.translation: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
verses.transliteration: wayaqūlūna a-innā latārikū ālihatinā lishāʿirin majnūnin

verses.translation: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,

verses.arabic: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.translation: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
verses.transliteration: wamā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna

verses.translation: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
Those will have a provision determined -
Fruits; and they will be honored
In gardens of pleasure
On thrones facing one another.
There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
White and delicious to the drinkers;

verses.arabic: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
verses.translation: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
verses.transliteration: lā fīhā ghawlun walā hum ʿanhā yunzafūna

verses.translation: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٞ
verses.translation: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].
verses.transliteration: qāla qāilun min'hum innī kāna lī qarīnun

verses.translation: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

verses.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
verses.translation: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
verses.transliteration: a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamadīnūna

verses.translation: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.

verses.arabic: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
verses.translation: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
verses.transliteration: walawlā niʿ'matu rabbī lakuntu mina l-muḥ'ḍarīna

verses.translation: Then, are we not to die

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.translation: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
verses.transliteration: illā mawtatanā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna

verses.translation: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

verses.arabic: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.translation: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?
verses.transliteration: adhālika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu l-zaqūmi

verses.translation: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٞ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
verses.transliteration: innahā shajaratun takhruju fī aṣli l-jaḥīmi

verses.translation: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
verses.translation: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
verses.transliteration: fa-innahum laākilūna min'hā famāliūna min'hā l-buṭūna

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبٗا مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ
verses.translation: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
verses.transliteration: thumma inna lahum ʿalayhā lashawban min ḥamīmin

verses.translation: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
Indeed they found their fathers astray.
So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
And We had already sent among them warners.
Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
"Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].
And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

verses.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
verses.translation: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
verses.transliteration: idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mādhā taʿbudūna

verses.translation: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?
Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
And he cast a look at the stars.
And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
So they turned away from him, departing.

verses.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
verses.translation: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
verses.transliteration: farāgha ilā ālihatihim faqāla alā takulūna

verses.translation: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?".
And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.
He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
While Allāh created you and that which you do?"

verses.arabic: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنٗا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."
verses.transliteration: qālū ib'nū lahu bun'yānan fa-alqūhu fī l-jaḥīmi

verses.translation: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
verses.translation: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
verses.transliteration: waqāla innī dhāhibun ilā rabbī sayahdīni

verses.translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

words.translation: So We gave him the glad tidings

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.translation: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."
verses.transliteration: falammā balagha maʿahu l-saʿya qāla yābunayya innī arā fī l-manāmi annī adhbaḥuka fa-unẓur mādhā tarā qāla yāabati if'ʿal mā tu'maru satajidunī in shāa l-lahu mina l-ṣābirīna

verses.translation: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
We called to him, "O Abraham,

words.translation: And We called out to him

verses.arabic: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.translation: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.transliteration: qad ṣaddaqta l-ru'yā innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna

verses.translation: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
"Peace upon Abraham."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.

words.translation: And We gave him glad tidings

verses.arabic: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنٞ وَظَالِمٞ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينٞ
verses.translation: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].
verses.transliteration: wabāraknā ʿalayhi waʿalā is'ḥāqa wamin dhurriyyatihimā muḥ'sinun waẓālimun linafsihi mubīnun

verses.translation: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,

words.translation: And We saved both of them

verses.translation: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],

words.translation: And We gave both of them

verses.translation: And We guided them on the straight path.

words.translation: And We guided both of them

verses.translation: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
"Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?
Do you call upon Baʿl and leave the best of creators -
Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
Except the chosen servants of Allāh.
And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
"Peace upon Elias."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
[So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].
Then We destroyed the others.
And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
And at night. Then will you not use reason?
And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
[Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
And he drew lots and was among the losers.
Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,

verses.arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
verses.translation: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
verses.transliteration: lalabitha fī baṭnihi ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna

verses.translation: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.

verses.arabic: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ
verses.translation: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
verses.transliteration: wa-arsalnāhu ilā mi-ati alfin aw yazīdūna

verses.translation: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?

verses.arabic: أَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثٗا وَهُمۡ شَٰهِدُونَ
verses.translation: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
verses.transliteration: am khalaqnā l-malāikata ināthan wahum shāhidūna

verses.translation: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
"Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
Has He chosen daughters over sons?
What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
Then will you not be reminded?
Or do you have a clear authority?
Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُۥ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبٗاۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ ٱلۡجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
verses.translation: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].
verses.transliteration: wajaʿalū baynahu wabayna l-jinati nasaban walaqad ʿalimati l-jinatu innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūna

verses.translation: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,
Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].
So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.

verses.arabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
verses.translation: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
verses.transliteration: wamā minnā illā lahu maqāmun maʿlūmun

verses.translation: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."
And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,

verses.arabic: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
verses.transliteration: law anna ʿindanā dhik'ran mina l-awalīna

verses.translation: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."
But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
[That] indeed, they would be those given victory
And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.
So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.
And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
Then for Our punishment are they impatient?

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
verses.translation: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
verses.transliteration: fa-idhā nazala bisāḥatihim fasāa ṣabāḥu l-mundharīna

verses.translation: And leave them for a time.
And see, for they are going to see.

verses.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.translation: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
verses.transliteration: sub'ḥāna rabbika rabbi l-ʿizati ʿammā yaṣifūna

verses.translation: And peace upon the messengers.
And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
